短文：
Watching films is one of the most enjoyable ways to learn a foreign language, but it works best when it is done with some {{1}}. Many learners simply switch on the subtitles in their own language and follow the story, which is entertaining but does little for their vocabulary. A better method is to watch a short scene twice: first with English subtitles and then without. On the second viewing, the brain is forced to {{2}} the sound of words with their meaning. It also helps to {{3}} difficult expressions in a notebook and to look them up afterwards. Research on vocabulary learning suggests that a word must be met many times before it is remembered, so choosing one film and watching it again after a week may be more {{4}} than watching five new films in a row. Teachers warn, however, that films should not {{5}} other kinds of practice. Speaking, reading and writing still need time. Used {{6}}, though, films can bring the language to life and remind learners why they are studying it. The {{7}} of the story also gives the brain something to hold on to, which makes new words easier to {{8}}. In short, films are not a {{9}} for hard work, but a {{10}} that makes the work more pleasant.

blanks.explain: 选 H. planning。with some planning 意为“有所计划”，与后文“不要只是打开母语字幕看故事”形成对比，空格需名词。
选 B. connect。connect A with B 意为“把 A 与 B 联系起来”，指把词的读音与意义对应起来，是语言学习的常用搭配。
选 J. record。record ... in a notebook 意为“把……记在笔记本里”，与 look them up afterwards 前后衔接；retain 强调记住，不接 in a notebook。
选 C. effective。more effective than 为比较级结构，effective 意为“有效的”，说明重复看同一部电影的学习效果可能更好。
选 K. replace。replace 意为“取代”，句中说明电影不应取代说、读、写等其他形式的练习，与后文 Speaking, reading and writing still need time 呼应。
选 O. wisely。used wisely 为过去分词短语作状语，意为“如果使用得当”，需要副词修饰 used。
选 I. plot。the plot of the story 意为“故事情节”，情节为大脑提供线索，使新词更容易记住。
选 L. retain。retain 意为“记住、保持”，easier to retain 表示新词更容易记住；record 强调记录动作，与“记住”语义不同。
选 M. substitute。a substitute for sth 意为“某物的替代品”，此处说明电影不能代替刻苦学习。
选 N. tool。a tool that makes the work more pleasant 意为“一种让学习更愉快的工具”，与前半句 not a substitute 形成对比。
